dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Rapid, high-rate geometric narrowing from the mid-section toward a sharp posterior point, forming a triangular profile.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins appear relatively smooth and linear with no significant asymmetrical bulges or indentations visible.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white with a pale blue-grey tint, high median pixel intensity.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Faint, vertical parallel linear marks (possible rake marks) visible on the left side of the dorsal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized faint linear scratches on the upper left quadrant of the visible dorsal surface.
